scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d redis minio
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d redis minio
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: pnpm --filter @message2/messaging prisma:migrate:deploy && pnpm --filter @message2/access-audit prisma:migrate:deploy && pnpm --filter @message2/notifications prisma:migrate:deploy
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -n gateway,messaging,media,notifications,audit,lawful "pnpm dev:gateway" "pnpm dev:messaging" "pnpm dev:media" "pnpm dev:notifications" "pnpm dev:audit" "pnpm dev:lawful"
scripts.dev:full: pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:migrate:deploy && pnpm dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,messaging,media,notifications,audit,lawful,web "pnpm dev:gateway" "pnpm dev:messaging" "pnpm dev:media" "pnpm dev:notifications" "pnpm dev:audit" "pnpm dev:lawful" "pnpm dev:web"
